notes: Per-tenant token-bucket rate limiter used by WorkerPool threads. No test setup, so one 'repo has no test setup' finding (medium, severity.md fixed rule 1) is expected and REAL. Also acceptable if raised (real, not seeded): requeue_throttled() has no caller in this slice, and throttled jobs are dropped on stop(). Also real (labeled 2026-11-19): constructor `overrides` skip the capacity >= 1 check that set_capacity enforces. Labeled 2026-11-20: requeue_throttled can keep looping while workers re-throttle jobs into _throttled = real. Adding a required `limiter` before `workers` changes the public constructor = real at most low (no callers in this repo); false at high.

defects.summary: try_acquire refills, checks and decrements a shared bucket without holding the lock; concurrent workers can both see tokens >= 1 and both send, so tenants exceed their rate limit
Mutable default overrides={} is shared by every TokenBucketLimiter built without overrides; set_capacity on one limiter changes the capacity used by all of them
